verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents one-tap creation of Linear tickets from incidents, with AI-suggested root-cause fixes, plus automated post-mortems built from the incident timeline and Slack. That covers pushing follow-up work into an issue tracker. There is no evidence that follow-up actions are tracked to completion inside Better Stack, or that ticket status syncs back. Missing for 10: follow-up action-item tracking through to completion, bidirectional status sync with the tracker, support for trackers beyond Linear (e.g. Jira), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
